title: Rampage
wikitext:
{{for|the challenge league|Rampage league}}

[[File:Rampage-screenshot.jpg|thumb|Tier 4 rampage effect]]
'''Rampage''' is a kill streak mechanic that provides rewards for killing increasing numbers of enemies without stopping. The rampage effect is only available for characters equipping certain items. 

==Mechanics==
The rampage counter keeps a running total of consecutive kills, including kills by [[proxies]] and [[minion]]s. When the character or a nearby [[party]] member fails to get a kill within five seconds of the previous kill, the rampage counter will reset to zero. When the counter reaches certain milestones, the character enters a new [[#Tiers|rampage tier]] and a special, beneficial effect is triggered. 

In addition to the tier effects, the [[character]] gains the following [[stat]]s:
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character"
 AND id NOT  LIKE "%max_rampage_stacks%" 
 AND id LIKE "%rampage%"
|format = ul
}}

The maximum rampage count is 1000 which gives a character a total of 50% increased movement speed and 100% increased damage. Kills after this number is reached will not increase the rampage count any more, but will renew the countdown.

You do not gain Rampage stacks if you have an active Rampage killstreak but no longer have any source of Rampage on your character.

{{il|Animate Guardian}} can't gain rampage, even if it meets the requirements of the relevant part of the equipment.

{{il|The Writhing Jar}}, {{il|Squirming Terror}}, {{il|Vaal Breach}} etc. can be used to sustain Rampage while there are no nearby enemies to kill, or if the only enemies are invulnerable, such as during certain boss immunity phases.

==Rampage tiers{{anchor|Tiers}}==
There are 13 rampage tiers. The number of kills required per tier remains the same throughout the parts.

==Trivia==
* Rampage was initially introduced in [[Rampage league]]. After the Rampage league ended, this mechanic was not added to the core game in an always-on way, and instead as an item mod.

* It was offered as a {{il|Map Device}} crafted area mod in [[version 2.3.0]], but it is not offered in recent 3.X era patches. Such map crafting option was removed from the map device in the [[version 3.28.0]] atlas rework.
